name: 12771 · Port Jervis, NY
findings: ZIP 12771 (Port Jervis) has 45 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (42% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 12771 (Port Jervis) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 12771 (Port Jervis) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).
